notes: Ethereum mainnet: one application deployment, GoblinNFT at index 0, built from this repository tree at its published commit. SOURCE NOTE FOR ADMISSION: the brief pinned commit fdb50e17659ad331d4f74921677bc110f3e4fec0, but the tree is that commit plus one verifier-accepted revision of src/GoblinNFT.sol (commit aa25ddd23c48f413724511aa28005b34f6247301, the fix for review finding ddc7c88f: refundable tokens could claim a full revenue share before release). GoblinArt.sol, foundry.toml and remappings.txt are byte-identical to fdb50e17. The manifest step changed no source; the requester must confirm this tree, not fdb50e17 byte-for-byte, as the deploy source before attestation. Build uses the repository foundry.toml: solc 0.8.26, optimizer enabled with 200 runs, Cancun, via_ir false, bytecode_hash none. The sole constructor argument is the static project wallet address 0xA7e99BB7155D7477E0C838E201b16E62B9c0b5Ac that the approved brief states as constructor word [0]; it becomes the Ownable owner, not the factory and not a protocol address. GoblinArt is internal and compiled into GoblinNFT. Mint opens on deployment: 10,000 live Goblins, 0.001 ETH each, maximum 20 mints per wallet. Holders can burn for the full mint price before sellout, during each seven-day target review, and from 90 days after sellout until release. Every setLaunchTargets call restarts review. Once sold out and review has ended, release() credits the remaining mint escrow 50/40/10 to the three destinations for collection through claimRelease(). A review completed before sellout permits release from the sellout block; this is accepted. The owner chooses contract destinations and may transfer ownership before release; code-size checks do not establish destination safety. These accepted powers remain subject to target review, and renunciation is available after release. Revenue: depositRevenue accepts ETH at any time. Before release() every deposit is pooled in deferredRevenue; nothing is credited to any token, claimRevenue settles nothing and returns 0, and pendingRevenue only shows a provisional equal share of the pool. release() splits the pool equally across the tokens live at that moment, retaining the division remainder. After release() deposits accrue to live tokens immediately and are claimable per token by its current holder; transfers carry unpaid revenue. refund() forfeits and retains nothing; the burned token's provisional share simply stays in the pool for the remaining holders. Rounding dust and zero-supply deposits are retained and logged. On-chain art and metadata logic are fixed. The accepted informational findings remain unchanged.
